subject: integration
name: IPFS standard (IPFS_0_1)
summary: A definition of IPFS_0_1: a read group (get, stat) and a store group (add, pin, unpin, pins) for files by content id. The answering node learns which content is asked for, and peers can see it fetched; store keeps files in the site's own space on this computer. The definition says bytes are checked against the content id but cannot make a node do it. It names a built-in decoder that only words the confirmation, and no node or address. Level 4 with privacy: the row runs and connects to nothing. Judged here by its publisher.
